notes.title: Metro Mini Market Simulator – Update 1.4 is Here!
notes.content:
[p][h1]📢 Metro Mini Market Simulator – Update 1.4 is Here![/h1]

Hey Shopkeepers!

We’re back with another exciting update to enhance your Metro Mini Market Simulator experience. Version 1.4 brings highly requested features, important fixes, and fresh content to keep your store thriving!

[h3]🆕 What’s New in 1.4[/h3]

[list]
[*] 🧍‍♂️ Beggar Option: You can now disable beggars from the Settings menu.
[*] 💳 MetroCard Machine Boost: Income from the MetroCard Machine has been doubled!
[*] 📦 Translation Fix: The “Holding a Box” end-of-day message is now correctly translated.
[*] 🏆 Achievements Added: 10 brand new achievements to unlock; can you collect them all?
[*] 🕒 Clock Issue Resolved: Time display bugs have been fixed for smoother gameplay flow.
[/list]

[h3]🎯 Reminder[/h3]
Make sure to explore the new achievements and tweak your gameplay settings for the best experience!

[h3]📌 Coming Soon[/h3]
We’re working on user experience and optimization improvements to make the game smoother than ever. Plus, a new feature is on the way: you'll soon be able to offer food to beggars, adding a new layer of choice and empathy to your shopkeeping experience.

Update now and let us know what you think. Your feedback keeps the market growing!

Happy selling,
Metro Mini Market Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Day 5 Update – Version 1.3 is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472971/d813679c7bb4fbf77318d2246ac07b066683944c.png[/img]

📢 Metro Mini Market Simulator – Update Now Live!

Hello, Shopkeepers!  

We’re excited to announce a new update for [b]Metro Mini Market Simulator[/b], bringing optimizations and fixes to improve your gameplay experience.  


[b]🛠 Changelog[/b]  
- Fixed issues with warehouse shelves to ensure smooth operation.  
- Cargo box mechanics have been improved for better functionality.  
- Optimized loading times for faster and smoother gameplay.  
- Updated maximum prices for better balance and gameplay dynamics.  


[b]Important Note:[/b]  
Don’t forget to adjust your maximum prices after updating to align with the new settings!  


[b]Looking Ahead:[/b]  
We’re actively working on more fixes and content updates, which will be coming your way in the days ahead. Stay tuned for more exciting improvements!  


Update your game now to enjoy the latest improvements. As always, your feedback is invaluable—let us know your thoughts and suggestions.  

[b]Happy managing![/b]

notes.title: Day 2 Update – Version 1.2 is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472971/4db46bfe3b3d61bdf1aff2cca5f2e60e5e2d0012.jpg[/img][h1]🛠️ Day 2 Update – Version 1.2 is Live![/h1]

Hey everyone,

We’ve just rolled out the Day 2 Update (v1.2) for Metro Mini Market Simulator! Thanks again for all the support and helpful feedback. Here’s what’s been added and improved in this version:

[h3]🔧 Changelog – Version 1.2[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where customers wouldn’t buy high-priced items from the drink fridge and magazine stand

[*] Added a new end-of-day mechanic to help structure gameplay

[*] Increased the ragdoll duration of the homeless character

[*] Adjusted and improved various sound effects
[/list]

[h2]🌍 Localization Note[/h2]
Language settings currently work only from the in-game settings menu.
We’re aware of this limitation and plan to make language selection available in the main menu in a future update. Thanks for your patience!

Thanks again for being part of the community. Keep the feedback coming — more improvements are on the way!

– Blackburne Games and Altai Team

notes.title: 🛠️ Day 1 Update is Live!
notes.content:
🛠️ Day 1 Update is Live! 
Hello everyone!
We’ve just pushed our first update for Metro Mini Market after launch. Thank you for all the feedback and support! Here’s what’s changed:

🔧 Patch Notes – Day 1 Changes:
🎵 Music tracks have been updated

📍 On first launch (if no save or quest progress), the player now starts in front of the store to properly trigger the signboard tutorial

⏱️ Warning durations have been extended

📱 The initial "Open Tablet" moment now includes a new animation

🔜 We’ll be releasing another update tomorrow with more improvements. Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472971/d813679c7bb4fbf77318d2246ac07b066683944c.png[/img]

notes.title: Metro Mini Market Simulator – Steam Next Fest Update
notes.content:
Metro Mini Market Simulator – Steam Next Fest Update

We Are Joining Steam Next Fest! (Feb 24 - Mar 3)

Your small market, your big ambitions!

Welcome to Metro Mini Market Simulator, where you manage, expand, and optimize your very own convenience store inside a bustling metro station!

We are thrilled to announce that Metro Mini Market Simulator, developed by Altai Entertainment and published by Blackburne Games Studio FZ LLC & Indienext, will be featured in Steam Next Fest from February 24 to March 3! 🎉
This is your chance to experience the business hustle firsthand with our free demo, available for a limited time!

🛒 What Awaits You in the Demo?

🏪 Build & Expand – Start with a small store and grow it into a metro station empire.
💰 Strategic Management – Balance stock, pricing, and customer demands to maximize profits.
🚆 Dynamic Customers – Serve a constantly moving crowd in a high-traffic metro station.

Your business, your rules—can you turn a tiny store into a thriving chain?

🎮 Play the FREE demo now and start building your market empire!
